purpose: Make Dashboard V2 K-line readable in the first viewport while keeping each selected model's difference versus the SOXLBacktest baseline visible.
ui_changes: Replaced the always-visible model-difference cards with one quick delta line plus a compact comparison table.
Kept the detailed historical model-difference table collapsed so the K-line and lower position/NAV panes remain visible.
Removed text from actor-cut and baseline-latest replay boundary markers so labels do not cover candles.
Capped recent model-difference markers to a smaller set to reduce K-line clutter.
Reduced first-viewport chart heights enough to show Model Position, Delta NAV vs Baseline, and Rebased NAV below the K-line.
verification: PYTHONPATH=. qlib_venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_dashboard_v2_layout.py tests/test_dashboard_v2_data.py tests/test_dashboard_v2_checker.py -q
